نتعاظم (form VI)
# نَتَعَاظَمُ (nataʕāẓamu) /na.ta.ʕaː.ðˤa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
# نَتَعَاظَمَ (nataʕāẓama) /na.ta.ʕaː.ðˤa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
# نَتَعَاظَمْ (nataʕāẓam) /na.ta.ʕaː.ðˤam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَاظَمَ (taʕāẓama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
